thread:
maria: OrbitChannel (GCP reseller) just raised a commission dispute for March. They say commission was paid at 5% but their signed reseller addendum shows 12% for enterprise customers. They attached settlement rows and the signed addendum. Can someone triage? :frowning:
ashok: Please paste the invoice/settlement lines they sent so we can see the numbers.
maria: Their attachments (copied):
Invoice we issued to customer (for reference):
```
INV-2026-03-5088
SKU: redwood_enterprise_d0
Qty: 2200 units
Unit price (net): $0.60
Line net: $1,320.00
```
OrbitChannel settlement row from GCP (as they received):
```
sku,units,unit_settled,commission_pct,commission_paid
redwood_enterprise_d0,2200,0.60,5,66.00
```
Signed reseller addendum (OrbitChannel): commission_pct = 12% for enterprise tier effective 2026-03-01. They claim shortfall = expected 12% * $1,320 = $158.40 so delta = $92.40.
julian: billing-bot, which commission profile did the marketplace exporter apply for merchant=orbitchannel on 2026-03-31? Also show timing of any commission-profile update jobs for March.
billing-bot: Export job for merchant=orbitchannel completed 2026-03-31T23:58Z. Commission profile applied: COMM_PROFILE_PUBLIC_5. Latest commission-sync job ran 2026-03-16T04:12Z and loaded rates from table reseller_commissions_v2 (last_updated=2026-03-16). Reseller contract record shows: effective_start=2026-03-01, commission_pct=12. However, legacy_commissions table still contained an entry 5% that the exporter falls back to when legacy alias present.
ashok: Sounds like a race: contract was uploaded to commissions_v2 on Mar 1, but the exporter still referenced legacy table for some SKU alias paths and picked 5%. Why would exporter fallback to legacy?
julian: Marketplace-connector has a compatibility branch that reads legacy_commissions for merchants created before 2025-09 to avoid breaking old entries. OrbitChannel is on that path. We had a migration step scheduled to sync legacy->v2 but it failed for OrbitChannel due to a schema mismatch on Mar 15. I filed ENG-PR-3089 to re-run the migration and to prevent fallback when a v2 record exists.
sophie: I opened GCP partner support ticket GP-99321. GCP confirms the metering rows reflect what we sent: commission_pct metadata was 5% in the metering payload. They suggested we correct our exporter and issue a settlement adjustment to OrbitChannel.
maria: Finance: OrbitChannel wants immediate confirmation they'll receive a backdated commission payment of $92.40. Can AP approve a provisional commission adjustment while engineering fixes mapping?
kelly: AP here. For reseller commission adjustments under $1,000 we can approve provisional payouts once we have: invoice id, computed delta, exporter logs showing incorrect profile, and partner contract. Please attach files and evidence.
maria: Attached: s3://redwood-billing/gcp/reconciliations/2026-03/orbitchannel-commission-delta-1800054321.csv and internal export https://internal.redwood/billing/exports/1800054321 (md5:6b1b36cbb04b41490bfc0ab2bfa26f86). Signed addendum scanned: s3://contracts/orbitchannel/addendum-2026-03-01.pdf. GCP ticket GP-99321.
julian: I'll own the exporter fix and migration re-run. Plan: 1) patch marketplace-connector to prefer reseller_commissions_v2 and error if legacy entry exists for the same sku+merchant (fail-fast) 2) re-run migration for OrbitChannel 3) add integration test that simulates overlapping legacy/v2 entries. ETA: PR by EOD and migration job scheduled for tomorrow morning.
ashok: Also add a monitoring alert that flags commission_pct changes for merchants after a pricing window closes, so finance gets notified before settlements run.
maria: Kelly, if AP approves provisional payout I'll draft payout instruction and route for signature. We should include a clawback clause in case our migration finds the contract wasn't in effect for the settled window.
kelly: I'll approve a provisional credit/payment memo for $92.40 (CM-2026-03-022) pending final audit. Must be labeled provisional with reimbursement clause. I'll create and route for approval. Posting ETA 2 business days.
sophie: I'll update OrbitChannel: told them we'll issue a provisional commission adjustment within 2 business days and follow up once engineering confirms exporter fix and migrations.
julian: After migration I'll run a sweep to detect any other merchants with mismatched legacy vs v2 commissions between 2026-02-20 and 2026-03-31 and post results. If total potential liability > $2k we escalate to Execs.
maria: Thanks. Leaving thread open until CM posted and migration completes. :thumbsup:
